payload.entry: Implemented: insertion now detects only unstruck child links and has a struck-history regression; project-note + rendering and the new-task project-block helper use configured status types, with a custom Cancelled regression; consumed @route:id emits kind="link_guard", a non-success human summary, and additive removed_pomodoro_links/day_file only when cleanup occurred; added the shifted-fence resident regression; documented consumed-shape omissions and added the bob-cli-73 renderer note. cargo fmt and git diff --check pass. Full just check is pending.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Continue investigating the two deterministic percent-listen CLI failures tracked by bob-cli-6m (percent_listen_reference_runs_existing_worker_and_installs_audio and failed_percent_listen_worker_keeps_listen_retry_guidance); this phase's just check reproduced both, while 1,405 CLI tests and all 2,451 unit tests passed. Phase verification: cargo fmt --check and git diff --check pass; the blocked-target consumed-link regression passes alone and now asserts the additive removed_pomodoro_links=1 and day_file fields emitted when cleanup occurs. The full just check otherwise passes clippy and all remaining targets. Capture JSON remains additive; implementation/docs/tests cover struck-link insertion, configured closed statuses, truthful consumed-link human/JSON output, and the fenced-index regression. No other skipped findings.

Planned cycler-blockid items, all done:
1. Recovery never strips #prj_is_blocked from closed lines (plan builder + apply paths; PDT7). Confirmed via recoverBlockedDependents and applyBlockedDependentRecoveryEdits.
2. Successor apply recovers Blocked→Ready without [unblocked::] when ledger-tools v12 is missing, warning once instead of dropping recoveries. Regression test fails on the old drop-edits guard.
3. Alt+] on a [?] ^prj that clears its last reason recovers open residents in the same gesture (tag strip + Ready + WRITE unblocked); remaining Depends-On keeps tags; closed lines untouched.
4. Restored block-id-prompt resident consumption test and a plugin-level notice-order test (dependency reasons before project date).
5. Cycler README/manifest 1.32.0→1.33.0; block-id-prompt 1.28.0→1.29.0; bob-cli docs in task-status-hooks.md and task-dependencies.md §13.10.
Deployed on this host: bob plugins sync -n -r <opened bob-plugins> -p task-status-cycler and -p block-id-prompt.
npm test: 2533 pass, 6 fail = allowed bob-cli-6v (4 unblocked-glyph), bob-cli-6w (Keep counts once), bob-cli-3w (ranker 17.26ms). just check: only the two bob-cli-6m percent-listen failures.

Completed capture fixes and documented additive JSON behavior. cargo fmt --check and git diff --check pass; the blocked-target consumed-link CLI regression passes alone.
